description: Intellectual-property portfolio of a French company from INPI open data: trademarks, patents and designs filed (counts + items with number, title, status, ISO dates and classification; trademarks also carry registration and expiry dates). Every date states what it is in date_nature, and every block its ordering in liste_ordre: trademarks and designs date-descending, patents NOT sorted upstream. An R&D/brand-value signal. Patent inventor names (natural persons) are never returned. Paid via x402 ($0.03 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: get_french_company_intellectual_property

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.

title: French company IP portfolio
